name: Sources: Where the Deck Pictures Live
description:
# Sources: where the deck pictures live, and their rights

For each deck on this site: the museums, libraries and sites that hold pictures of it, how sharp
those pictures are, and **what their rights allow**, in the holder's own words where they could be
read. Each source also says plainly who holds the rights and what we may and may not do.

**Three ways in.** Selections by **deck**, by **holder** (Yale, the BnF, the Morgan, Commons…) and
by **rights** (free for any use · open licence · non-commercial only · permission needed · unclear ·
in copyright). A source can sit in several.

**Links only.** This grammar copies no pictures. A source shows an image only where its own
statement says public domain, CC0 or CC BY.

**Not legal advice.** A Commons "public domain" tag is the uploader's claim about the work, not a
grant from whoever made the scan. Checked 2026-10-20.

Every card image shown today that is non-commercial-only, a scan of a modern reproduction, or of
unclear origin is listed, card by card, with a free alternative where one is known, in
[IMAGE-FLAGS.md](https://github.com/PlayfulProcess/recursive-tarot/blob/main/docs/rights/IMAGE-FLAGS.md).

*Built by `scripts/build_sources_grammar.py` from `research/sources/image-sources.json`.*

metadata.holder_name: Warburg Institute Archive, University of London
metadata.rights_label: Permission needed to publish

sections.Property rights: The papers belong to the Warburg; Crowley's and Harris's work is still in copyright in the UK (Harris d. 1962). Ask the Warburg, and the rights holders, before any reproduction.
sections.Holder: Warburg Institute Archive, University of London
sections.What it holds: Gerald Yorke's collection of Crowley and Golden Dawn papers (Cypher manuscripts, Order documents; catalogues in two series, OS and NS), and Lady Frieda Harris's original Thoth paintings (1938-1943). Whether a manuscript Book T or a painted Order deck is among the papers was not confirmed.
sections.Quality: Originals, seen by appointment in the reading room; the catalogue lists are PDFs (e.g. https://warburg.sas.ac.uk/sites/default/files/Yorke%20Collection%20NS%201%20-%2049.pdf).
sections.Rights as published: The archive page says permission to view the manuscripts must be requested in advance. No image licence was found online.

sections.Property rights: Yale owns the cards; the 15th-century paintings are public domain and Yale's policy lets anyone use its open-access images for any purpose, with "Yale University Library" as provider. We may show, print and sell them; credit Yale.

sections.Quality: Full size 3,256 x 5,640 px per card (IIIF level 2; TIFF, JPG, PNG). Since Oct 19 2026 this site shows Yale's full-size files unaltered (they replaced 1,100 x 1,905 px copies).

The person using the image is liable for any infringement." Provider: "Yale University Library". Yale's open-access policy (guides.library.yale.edu/openaccess): "Open access digital images may be used by anyone for any purpose." It covers works believed public domain; "The policy does not apply to works protected by copyright, by privacy rights, or that are otherwise restricted."
